Overview of Fribourg Region (Fribourg)

Fribourg Region (Fribourg) is located in the Fribourg region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Fribourg. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionFribourg
Capital cityFribourg
Cities & municipalities21
Primary transport hubFribourg Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Fribourg Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Fribourg

When visiting cities across Fribourg, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Fribourg

Best time to visit Fribourg: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
